```{r}
#|echo: false

#read in required packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

mat_neo_data <- read_excel(here('data/MatNeoSIP.xlsx'), sheet = 'Data') |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename('stage_7_all' = 'stage_7') |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., 'x', 'stage_'), starts_with('x'))
```
